content: As someone fills in a form, a working copy is saved in {{inProgress}}. It counts as a response only after submission. People invited as {{formFiller}} see only their own responses.

comment.text: Body of the Forms onboarding tour step that highlights the In progress folder inside a sample form space. {{inProgress}} is the translated folder name; {{formFiller}} is the translated role name (Form filler).

usage.context:
// 8. In progress.
 showInsideSpace &&
 revealStep(
 IN_PROGRESS_SELECTOR,
 t("FormsTour:FormsInProgressTitle"),
 t("FormsTour:FormsInProgress", {
 inProgress: t("Common:InProgress"),
 formFiller: t("Common:RoleFormFiller"),
 }),
 callbacks,
 FORMS_TOUR_LABEL,
